rules.简短承接: 以必要短句接住玩家刚才的言行，随即转入新的反应与后果。保持原意和行动的确定程度。
rules.润色转述: 把玩家本轮输入作为本段大纲，按事件次序展开已给言行、动作过程、场景反馈与获准心理，润色成完整场面，再沿该场面向下扩写延续。写足输入包含的过程，保持原意、先后关系与确定程度。行动尝试依情境判定结果；新增玩家言行与心理遵守各自授权。

rows.label: 故事基调

rules.随世界设定: 沿用世界基调，使日常与冲突保持同一世界的生活质感。场外的缇斯亚珍惜愿望，愿玩家幸福，关心藏于倦懒与毒舌。
rules.明亮: 采用明亮基调，让人物的善意与行动带来有依据的回应。场外的缇斯亚愿玩家幸福，关心藏于毒舌。
rules.冷峻: 采用冷峻基调，直接呈现现实限制与选择代价，保留人物的具体生活。场外的缇斯亚保留对幸福的祝愿。
rules.诙谐: 采用诙谐基调，笑点从人物性格、处境与互动生长。场外的缇斯亚以促狭与毒舌表达关心。
rules.悬疑: 采用悬疑基调，依来源和揭示进度安排线索，让疑问对应实际未知。场外的缇斯亚珍惜愿望，发言保持知情边界。
rules.悲剧（BE）: 采用悲剧底色，损失与遗憾由人物选择、既定冲突及现实代价形成。场外的缇斯亚嫉妒玩家的幸福，怨怼自身无法解释的失落；发言服从 @self_known。

do_not_inject_as_narrative_config.reason: Backend selection/request parameters, not story instructions; distinct from prompt detail. Credentials stay host-owned.
Select/filter actual materials and binding before send; prompt sees result, not UI selection workflow or budget mechanics.
Schedule, retrieve and persist host-side. Send only actual selected task/context; do not list all switches as narrative model work.
nativeBridge selects actual native update owner and relevant contract; old 缇斯亚MVU兼容=true currently rejected by validateConfig, so do not enable fake executor.
Renderer and UI settings never sent as story-writing rules, except an actual enabled component output protocol.

english_review_config.value_basis: Existing model defaults, except modern character bilingual dialogue explicitly enabled for review and the two requested new voice controls selected as directed. Dynamic placeholders require actual selected text, otherwise omit the whole field.

new_review_values.preserve_user_idiolect: preserve within author authority and explicit constraints
new_review_values.follow_user_narrative_voice: follow the user's current narration only; no dialogue/OOC mixing, no plot copying or extra agency

unexpanded_value_rules: Apply a custom selected option wording at its owning field, replacing that field rather than appending a duplicate generic version.

Resolve seven matched preference placeholders to disjoint category projections of enabled confirmed rows. Each information point appears once; carry actual scope, force, exception and supported intensity.
Render the selected main and supplementary style resources once. C01 legacy default is not added.
Render only enabled literal/regex/instruction rows once. Literal Chinese bans and regex patterns remain exact data even when surrounding instruction text is English.
Initiative is omitted when absent or inactive; it is not silently set to a new mode.
Selected extension data facts go to the gameplay/material slot; selected behavior requirements go to their owning preference field; markup protocol goes to the output contract.
Task instructions belong only to the selected auxiliary task, never all in the narrative block.
Guide detail controls emitted guide text and is not another model reasoning budget.
Explicit boundaries and hard-rule rows are classified once, not duplicated under every category.
